title: I made a free browser + Android + PC MMORPG where you combine two skills into one new move – Sunmere Online
author: Realistic_Warthog_85
selftext:
Hi all! I've been building Sunmere Online, a small free fantasy MMORPG (with a lot of help from AI tools), and the online world is now up 24/7. I'd love some players and honest feedback.

**Play free:** https://dhrubo95zd.itch.io/sunmere-online

(browser, Windows and Android – no payment, optional donation)

**What makes it different**

\- **Skill fusion:** instead of 20 buttons, each class has 7 skills. Use two in a row and they fuse into a new move – e.g. the Knight's Rising Slash into Skybreaker becomes Stormfall, a leap into the air and a slam back down.

\- **A Path of Exile–style Skill Web** that changes how your skills behave, with keystones that rework whole moves.

\- **7 classes:** Knight, Warden, Sandblade, Ranger, Deadeye, Chemist and Herbalist.

\- **Bosses with weak moments:** after a big attack they stagger, and that's when your fusions hit hardest.

\- **Main story, dungeons, raids, houses you can enter**, and a world of steam-powered machines instead of monsters.

\- **Plays on a phone too**, with the same characters as on PC (sign in with Google).

**Honest notes**

\- It's early and the player count is small. There are helper bots in the world so it never feels empty; they're always marked "(bot)".

\- No music: the soundtrack is quiet voice-only humming. That's a deliberate choice.

\- Made by one person with AI help, so expect rough edges.

What would make you keep playing? Any bugs, ideas or "this feels clunky" comments are very welcome – I read everything.
